name: FT-Transformer upgrade, validation-selected exploratory follow-up
selection_metric: validation average precision; recall@1pct secondary tie breaker
validation_stretch_target: AP at least 0.02 above strongest matched LightGBM, with no recall@1pct degradation
test_policy: Original test has already been viewed. No test labels or predictions are used by search. One locked final comparison is exploratory, not a new untouched test.
baseline_policy: Preserve all original files. Refit LightGBM on each added representation and include stronger matched tree settings. Do not weaken the baseline.
